hold_conditions: Retain the USOIL analytical watch only if the next independent balance evidence confirms the mechanism; require current curve and cost checks before a separate holding decision.

horizon_blocks.outlook: USOIL conditional short outlook: Over five sessions, identify the next actual release/quote reaction and distinguish a surprise from carry or position adjustment. The original EIA 8.6m-barrel crude draw can tighten available supply, but the 791000 b/d import fall can explain part of it without stronger demand. Gasoline built 3.5m barrels and four-week demand was 0.4% lower YoY. Confirmation required: Subsequent crude/product balances, normalized imports/exports, current WTI curve and a separately captured pre-release expectation. No target or probability is estimated.

USOIL conditional swing outlook: Over 21 sessions, require repeat releases and relative price/curve confirmation before retaining the proposed transmission. The original EIA 8.6m-barrel crude draw can tighten available supply, but the 791000 b/d import fall can explain part of it without stronger demand. Gasoline built 3.5m barrels and four-week demand was 0.4% lower YoY. Confirmation required: Subsequent crude/product balances, normalized imports/exports, current WTI curve and a separately captured pre-release expectation. No target or probability is estimated.

USOIL conditional long outlook: Over 63 sessions, compare cumulative cash-flow, supply/demand or policy changes with valuation and annualized vehicle costs; an old price pattern is insufficient. Confirmation required: Subsequent crude/product balances, normalized imports/exports, current WTI curve and a separately captured pre-release expectation. No target or probability is estimated.

limitations: CC analysis is not external confirmation or an order.
No private holdings/account context is included.
